name: Boom Entertainment
desc:
CSR | $20-$25| Chat & Email Support | Industry: Daily Fantasy Sports / Gaming / Tech Startup | 
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/boomentertainment/jobs/5992933004

This is a contract-to-hire role for US candidates, not a direct hire. That means participants start as contractors, likely without full benefits, and may convert to permanent employment after a period of time. Benefits and conversion terms are not disclosed.
Before You Apply: Resume Tips for this ATS
Because you are applying directly through the employer’s Applicant Tracking System, your resume needs to be optimized for their software:
Make sure the words “Customer Support,” “Zendesk,” and “Intercom” appear in your past experience if applicable.
Highlight any specific experience you have with Zendesk and Intercom.
Ensure your resume clearly states that you are looking for Full-Time work, so the recruiter knows you are aligned with the role.

Realistic Job Overview and Responsibilities:
Boom Sports is a daily fantasy sports app where users enter contests and win real money. This role supports those users when something goes wrong or they have questions about their account, contest results, payments, or identity verification.
Key responsibilities from the posting:
Handle high-volume customer support via email and live chat using Zendesk and Intercom
Resolve contest inquiries, account questions, and billing issues
Verify user identities during sign-up
Monitor for site issues and escalate to the appropriate internal channels quickly
Handle withdrawal status questions and gameplay inquiries
Escalate complex issues to the right teams with appropriate detail
This is a chat and email-first role. Phone contact is not mentioned. Support is time-sensitive because users are interacting with live sports contests and real money. Issues need fast, accurate responses during game windows including nights and weekends.

other:
Employee reviews note that sports-related work means irregular hours since issues arise during live games, including weekend mornings and Friday nights. The Sunday through Thursday initial schedule reflects that. Participants need to be honest with themselves about whether that schedule works for their life
The posting does something unusual by openly stating who this role is not for. That language is worth reading with participants directly. Boom is telling applicants exactly what they expect. If a participant reads the "not for you" section and recognizes themselves in it, this is not the right fit.
Career Pathway: Customer Support Representative → Senior Support Representative → Support Operations Specialist → Support Team Lead → Head of Customer Support
